meta.method: Weighted: originality x2, footage x2, safety x1.5, interference, convenience/stow, simplicity, technical risk (5=low risk) x1; killed concepts excluded; family overlap noted

ranking.reason: Only transfer whose energy source is new AND free: descent pays flight (propulsion ~1 Wh/day vs camera ~1.9 Wh), 95 g / <=14.9 J by design, nothing on the body but a 1.2 L quiver, 51 min per 4 Wh. Market and patent search found no fixed-wing/gravity ski follow-cam.
ranking.biggest_risk: Low-Re glide polar of a folding+morphing 95 g airframe (L/D at 12 m/s swept must be >=4) and snow-landing pickup ops (3 strict).

ranking.reason: Same energy insight, but hover at launch/land gives 2 ops and button-launch at standstill; Si-anode keeps it at 115 g.
ranking.biggest_risk: Tail-sitter transition and cradle docking in gusts with props near the head; KE cap drops to 16.1 m/s.

ranking.reason: Turns S2-01 into a zero-standstill product: capture at 1-2 m/s closing speed (0.03-0.3 J).
ranking.biggest_risk: Skier wake turbulence and line flutter during capture 2-3 m behind the head.

ranking.reason: Cheapest upgrade to the user-requested kite: crosswind figure-8 lowers minimum skier speed from 6.2 to ~2.2 m/s and the view from 74 deg to ~35-50 deg.
ranking.biggest_risk: Periodic orbit in footage and tether sweep near a turning skier; still lands at stops.

killed: S2-12 guided parafoil (glide 18 deg, 13 m miss)
breakthroughs_that_change_the_picture: Si-anode cells 450 Wh/kg (Amprius 2025): makes a 4 Wh, 10 g day battery; also ~3x cold endurance for market quads (not original)
Bird-inspired sweep morphing (LisHawk 2020): cuts glider propulsion ~5x for fast skiers by covering 6-16 m/s
Loitering-munition folding wings + tube launch: 1.2 L stow and one-motion deploy
Regenerative soaring windprop (Velis, TU Delft): turns steep pitches into stop-orbit energy
UWB (10-15 cm) + 3 mW event/ToF sensors: precise close-range relative navigation for pursuit, landing and hook capture
Gyroflow-style gyro-log stabilisation + subject-locked reframing: removes the gimbal; residual background jitter 0.1-0.4 deg/s
EU 2019/947 follow-me exemption (<=50 m, A1, C0 <=19 m/s): a legal path for a 95 g follow-glider in the EU (resort rules still decide)
